_doc: LIGHTING-PAIR-1 -- the 'identical light, two chassis classes' comparison,
as a fixture instead of a bespoke per-session improvisation.
WHAT IT ANSWERS: do vehicles and mechs actually light differently, at the
same world position, under the same sun? Every previous attempt at this
was uninterpretable because the two arms were not comparable:
- movers drift run-to-run, so a turret barrel resting at a different aim
angle read as '+14.8 luma brighter' (that result was RETRACTED),
- and the sun could only be whatever the mission happened to author.
freeze_movers + set_light remove both. The four captures below differ in
EXACTLY ONE variable each.
REQUIRED ENV (all three, or the run silently proves nothing):
MC2_UI_COMMAND_FILE=<path>   the channel itself
MC2_TEST_SPAWN=1             arms spawn/teleport
MC2_SMOKE_FIXED_TIMESTEP=1   without it frameLength is wall-clock and
'frame 900' is a different simulated instant
in every build -- the freeze is then
reproducible within one process only.
WHY freeze AT A FRAME and not just 'freeze now': arming for frame 900 makes
this pose reproducible across a REBUILD, which is what lets you compare a
capture taken before a fix with one taken after it. 'freeze_movers on' with
no frame pins whenever the driver's write landed, which is not the same
instant twice.
READ THE RESULT AS: compare mech_day vs vehicle_day (chassis class, light
held constant) and mech_day vs mech_night (light, chassis held constant).
The cross pair mech_day vs vehicle_night answers nothing -- two variables.

steps._c: Put a mech and a vehicle at KNOWN, adjacent coordinates so the only
steps.__c: difference between the two subjects is the chassis class.

steps._c: Pin everything at a deterministic frame, THEN verify the latch fired.
Frame the pair, then hold the camera for the rest of the run.
Sun ALTITUDE sweep at constant colour: isolates the terrain/mover
steps.__c: lighting response from the ambient+fog recompute that set_light

steps._c: Prove the freeze held for the WHOLE run. If this fails, every
steps.__c: capture above is incomparable and the run is void.
